注 2：COMFY-MANAGER 目前无法检测组节点中的自定义节点。您必须仔细阅读此列表并手动安装每个自定义节点系列。

IPAdapter 的简单实现，可与 NoobAI/Illustrious 一起使用。旨在模仿给定的任何图像的整体风格，并且在将两个图像组合在一起时可以创建一些独特的风格，例如一个作为图像输入，一个作为负图像输入。作为注释包含在工作流程中所需的所有模型的下载链接。

NOTE 1: REQUIRES THE LATEST VERSION OF COMFYUI AND COMFY FRONTEND AS OF THE TIME OF POSTING THIS WORKFLOW. IT USES THE NEW GROUP NODE FEATURE.

NOTE 2: COMFY-MANAGER CURRENTLY CANNOT DETECT CUSTOM NODES IN A GROUP NODE. YOU WILL HAVE TO GO THROUGH THIS LIST AND MANUALLY INSTALL EACH OF THESE CUSTOM NODE FAMILIES.

  1. comfyui_ipadapter-plus

  2. RES4LYF

  3. was-node-suite-comfyui

  4. comfyui_essentials

  5. Easy-Use

  6. Custom-Scripts

  7. comfyui-ppm

  8. rgthree-comfy

  9. comfyui-prompt-reader-node

A straightforward implementation for IPAdapter for usage with NoobAI/Illustrious. Intended to mimic the overall style of any image given to it, and can create some unique styles when combining two images together, like one as the image input and one as the negative image input. Download links for all models required included in the workflow as a note.
